تعتصرين (form VIII)
# تَعْتَصِرِينَ (taʕtaṣirīna) /taʕ.ta.sˤi.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
# تُعْتَصَرِينَ (tuʕtaṣarīna) /tuʕ.ta.sˤa.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
